title: Linux 7.2
summary: Igalia announces the release of Linux kernel version 7.2, a point release that includes upstream kernel improvements, bug fixes, and hardware support updates. As a company known for contributions to browser engines and graphics stack, Igalia likely highlights kernel changes relevant to their focus areas like graphics drivers and Vulkan/OpenGL support.
problem_solved: Delivers the latest kernel improvements, security patches, and hardware enablement for Linux-based systems.
why_valuable: Point releases of the Linux kernel provide critical stability fixes and new hardware support that benefit millions of servers, desktops, and embedded devices running Linux worldwide.
